commands.name: device.health
commands.description: The gadget's battery level and whether it is charging (on a gadget with a battery), uptime, free memory, its Wi-Fi network and firmware version.

commands.name: device.discover
commands.description: Scan the home network the gadget is on for other devices and services (ARP, mDNS, SSDP, WS-Discovery, SNMP and NetBIOS) for up to 90 seconds. Answers with the gadget's own address and what each source saw.

sources.description: The sources to scan with; all when left out.

items.description: One device or service seen, with the source that saw it.

sources.description: Per source: how many it found and whether it stopped at a limit.

complete.description: false when a source failed or stopped at a limit.
